```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# TCGA VALIDATION — 2-miRNA Non-Targeted NSCLC
# Refined & unified pipeline
#
# Signature (2-miRNA — hsa-miR-378h dropped: 99% zero RPM in TCGA RNA-seq):
#   hsa-miR-509-3p  β = +0.743073677989302  (Risk)
#   hsa-miR-377-3p  β = +0.502724385364305  (Risk)
#
# Pipeline:
#   PART 0  — Prerequisites: verify log2 columns exist in CSVs
#   PART 1  — Define signature
#   PART 2  — Load MAF + cBioPortal fusion → build targeted case lists
#   PART 3  — Filter non-targeted, fix types
#   PART 4  — Z-score WITHIN non-targeted subset → recompute 2-miRNA score
#   PART 5  — Validation function
#   PART 6  — Validate full non-targeted cohorts
#   PART 7  — Stage annotation + subsets
#   PART 8  — Summary table + export
# ==============================================================================

library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(maftools)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(timeROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ==============================================================================
# PART 0 — Prerequisite: verify log2 columns exist in risk score CSVs
#
# If log2 columns are missing, run the injection block below (set RUN = TRUE).
# If CSVs already have log2_hsa_miR_509_3p and log2_hsa_miR_377_3p → skip.
# ==============================================================================

RUN_LOG2_INJECTION <- !all(c("log2_hsa_miR_509_3p", "log2_hsa_miR_377_3p") %in%
                          colnames(read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv", nrows = 2)))  # TRUE if log2 columns are missing

if (RUN_LOG2_INJECTION) {

  luad_mirna_df <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_miRNA_df.rds")
  lusc_mirna_df <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_miRNA_df.rds")
  cat("✓ miRNA RDS files loaded\n")

  # Only inject 509-3p and 377-3p (378h excluded — platform dropout)
  sig_mirnas_inject <- c("hsa-miR-509-3p", "hsa-miR-377-3p")

  mature_to_precursor <- list(
    "hsa-miR-509-3p" = c("hsa-mir-509-1", "hsa-mir-509-2", "hsa-mir-509-3"),
    "hsa-miR-377-3p" = c("hsa-mir-377")
  )

  log2_cols_inject <- paste0("log2_", gsub("-", "_", sig_mirnas_inject))

  extract_log2_2mir <- function(mirna_df, cohort_name) {
    cat("\n[EXTRACT]", cohort_name, "\n")
    rpm_cols           <- grep("^reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_TCGA-",
                                colnames(mirna_df), value = TRUE)
    expr_rpm           <- as.matrix(mirna_df[, rpm_cols])
    mode(expr_rpm)     <- "numeric"
    rownames(expr_rpm) <- mirna_df$miRNA_ID
    colnames(expr_rpm) <- sub("^reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_", "",
                               colnames(expr_rpm))

    expr_sig <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(mature_to_precursor), function(mature) {
      pf  <- mature_to_precursor[[mature]]
      pf  <- pf[pf %in% rownames(expr_rpm)]
      if (length(pf) == 0) stop("Precursor not found for: ", mature)
      row <- if (length(pf) == 1) expr_rpm[pf, , drop = FALSE]
             else matrix(colSums(expr_rpm[pf, , drop = FALSE]), nrow = 1)
      rownames(row) <- mature
      row
    }))

    stype    <- substr(colnames(expr_sig), 14, 15)
    expr_sig <- expr_sig[, stype == "01", drop = FALSE]
    case_ids <- substr(colnames(expr_sig), 1, 12)
    dups     <- duplicated(case_ids)
    expr_sig <- expr_sig[, !dups, drop = FALSE]
    case_ids <- toupper(case_ids[!dups])
    cat("  Samples after primary filter:", length(case_ids), "\n")

    mode(expr_sig) <- "numeric"
    log2_mat       <- log2(expr_sig + 1)

    log2_df           <- as.data.frame(t(log2_mat[sig_mirnas_inject, , drop = FALSE]))
    colnames(log2_df) <- log2_cols_inject
    log2_df$case_id   <- case_ids
    log2_df
  }

  luad_log2 <- extract_log2_2mir(luad_mirna_df, "TCGA-LUAD")
  lusc_log2 <- extract_log2_2mir(lusc_mirna_df, "TCGA-LUSC")

  for (cohort in c("LUAD", "LUSC")) {
    csv_path <- paste0("TCGA_", cohort, "_risk_scores_3mir.csv")
    log2_tbl <- if (cohort == "LUAD") luad_log2 else lusc_log2
    rs_df    <- read.csv(csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    rs_df    <- rs_df[, !colnames(rs_df) %in% log2_cols_inject]
    merged   <- rs_df %>% left_join(log2_tbl, by = "case_id")
    write.csv(merged, csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("✓ %s updated — %d cols\n", csv_path, ncol(merged)))
  }
}

# Verify log2 columns present before proceeding
luad_check <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv",
                        nrows = 2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
required_log2 <- c("log2_hsa_miR_509_3p", "log2_hsa_miR_377_3p")
missing <- required_log2[!required_log2 %in% colnames(luad_check)]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("Missing log2 columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
       "\nSet RUN_LOG2_INJECTION <- TRUE and re-run PART 0.")
}
cat("✓ PART 0 — log2 columns verified.\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 1 — Define 2-miRNA signature
# ==============================================================================

beta_2mir <- c(
  "log2_hsa_miR_509_3p" =  0.743073677989302,
  "log2_hsa_miR_377_3p" =  0.502724385364305
)
log2_cols_2mir <- names(beta_2mir)

cat("\n=== 2-miRNA Signature ===\n")
print(data.frame(
  miRNA  = c("hsa-miR-509-3p", "hsa-miR-377-3p"),
  beta   = as.numeric(beta_2mir),
  HR     = c(2.102, 1.653),
  p      = c(0.00968, 0.0333),
  note   = c("Risk factor", "Risk factor")
))
cat("Note: hsa-miR-378h excluded — 99% zero RPM in TCGA RNA-seq (platform dropout)\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 2 — Load MAF + cBioPortal fusions → build targeted case lists
# ==============================================================================

# ── 2a. Load MAF (download once, then reload from saved objects) ──────────────
RUN_MAF_DOWNLOAD <- !all(file.exists(c("TCGA_LUAD_MAF.rds", "TCGA_LUSC_MAF.rds")))  # download on first run

if (RUN_MAF_DOWNLOAD) {

  get_maf <- function(project) {
    query <- GDCquery(project       = project,
                      data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
                      data.type     = "Masked Somatic Mutation",
                      access        = "open")
    GDCdownload(query, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 10)
    GDCprepare(query)
  }

  luad_maf_raw <- get_maf("TCGA-LUAD")
  lusc_maf_raw <- get_maf("TCGA-LUSC")
  saveRDS(luad_maf_raw, "TCGA_LUAD_MAF.rds")
  saveRDS(lusc_maf_raw, "TCGA_LUSC_MAF.rds")
  cat("✓ MAF files saved.\n")

} else {
  luad_maf_raw <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_MAF.rds")
  lusc_maf_raw <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_MAF.rds")
  cat("✓ MAF files loaded from RDS.\n")
}

luad_maf <- luad_maf_raw %>%
  mutate(case_id = substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12))
lusc_maf <- lusc_maf_raw %>%
  mutate(case_id = substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12))

cat("LUAD MAF — unique cases:", n_distinct(luad_maf$case_id), "\n")
cat("LUSC MAF — unique cases:", n_distinct(lusc_maf$case_id), "\n")

# ── 2b. Load cBioPortal fusion files ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Download from:
#   https://www.cbioportal.org/study/summary?id=luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018
#   https://www.cbioportal.org/study/summary?id=lusc_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018
# Unzip → data_sv.txt

luad_sv <- read.delim("luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_sv.txt",
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lusc_sv <- read.delim("lusc_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_sv.txt",
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ── 2c. MAF-based targeted cases ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Exclusion rationale:
#   EGFR    — all mutations (erlotinib/gefitinib/osimertinib)
#   KRAS    — G12C only (sotorasib/adagrasib)
#   BRAF    — V600E only (dabrafenib+trametinib)
#   MET     — exon 14 skipping only (capmatinib/tepotinib)
#   ERBB2   — exon 20 ins/dup only (T-DXd; other mutations are passengers)
#   NTRK1/2/3 — all (larotrectinib/entrectinib)
#   ALK/ROS1/RET — fusion-based (handled via fusion file below)

get_maf_targeted <- function(maf_df) {
  maf_df %>%
    filter(
      (Hugo_Symbol == "EGFR") |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "KRAS"  & HGVSp_Short == "p.G12C") |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "BRAF"  & HGVSp_Short == "p.V600E") |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "MET"   & grepl("splice|Splice|exon.?14|\\b14\\b",
                                       HGVSp_Short, ignore.case = TRUE)) |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "ERBB2" & grepl("ins|dup",
                                       HGVSp_Short, ignore.case = TRUE)) |
      (Hugo_Symbol %in% c("NTRK1", "NTRK2", "NTRK3"))
    ) %>%
    pull(case_id) %>%
    unique()
}

luad_maf_targeted <- get_maf_targeted(luad_maf)
lusc_maf_targeted <- get_maf_targeted(lusc_maf)

# Per-gene breakdown
for (cohort in c("LUAD", "LUSC")) {
  maf_df <- if (cohort == "LUAD") luad_maf else lusc_maf
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s MAF targeted breakdown ---\n", cohort))
  maf_df %>%
    filter(
      (Hugo_Symbol == "EGFR") |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "KRAS"  & HGVSp_Short == "p.G12C") |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "BRAF"  & HGVSp_Short == "p.V600E") |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "MET"   & grepl("splice|Splice|exon.?14|\\b14\\b",
                                       HGVSp_Short, ignore.case = TRUE)) |
      (Hugo_Symbol == "ERBB2" & grepl("ins|dup",
                                       HGVSp_Short, ignore.case = TRUE)) |
      (Hugo_Symbol %in% c("NTRK1", "NTRK2", "NTRK3"))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Hugo_Symbol) %>%
    summarise(n_cases  = n_distinct(case_id),
              variants = paste(unique(HGVSp_Short)[1:min(3,
                                 n_distinct(HGVSp_Short))],
                               collapse = ", "),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_cases)) %>%
    print()
}

# ── 2d. Fusion-based targeted cases (ALK / ROS1 / RET) ───────────────────────
fusion_genes <- c("ALK", "ROS1", "RET")

get_fusion_targeted <- function(sv_df) {
  sv_df %>%
    filter(Site1_Hugo_Symbol %in% fusion_genes |
           Site2_Hugo_Symbol %in% fusion_genes) %>%
    mutate(case_id = substr(Sample_Id, 1, 12)) %>%
    pull(case_id) %>%
    unique()
}

luad_fusion_targeted <- get_fusion_targeted(luad_sv)
lusc_fusion_targeted <- get_fusion_targeted(lusc_sv)

# Fusion breakdown
for (cohort in c("LUAD", "LUSC")) {
  sv_df <- if (cohort == "LUAD") luad_sv else lusc_sv
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s fusion targeted breakdown ---\n", cohort))
  sv_df %>%
    filter(Site1_Hugo_Symbol %in% fusion_genes |
           Site2_Hugo_Symbol %in% fusion_genes) %>%
    mutate(case_id = substr(Sample_Id, 1, 12),
           driver  = ifelse(Site1_Hugo_Symbol %in% fusion_genes,
                            Site1_Hugo_Symbol, Site2_Hugo_Symbol)) %>%
    group_by(driver) %>%
    summarise(n_cases = n_distinct(case_id),
              example = paste(unique(Event_Info)[1:min(3,
                                n_distinct(Event_Info))],
                              collapse = " | "),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()
}

# ── 2e. Union ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
luad_all_targeted <- union(luad_maf_targeted, luad_fusion_targeted)
lusc_all_targeted <- union(lusc_maf_targeted, lusc_fusion_targeted)

cat("\n═══ EXCLUSION SUMMARY ═══\n")
cat("LUAD — MAF:", length(luad_maf_targeted),
    "| Fusion:", length(luad_fusion_targeted),
    "| Total excluded:", length(luad_all_targeted), "\n")
cat("LUSC — MAF:", length(lusc_maf_targeted),
    "| Fusion:", length(lusc_fusion_targeted),
    "| Total excluded:", length(lusc_all_targeted), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 3 — Load risk score CSVs, filter non-targeted, fix types
# ==============================================================================

luad_df <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lusc_df <- read.csv("TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Overlap check
cat("\nLUAD — targeted cases found in CSV:",
    sum(luad_df$case_id %in% luad_all_targeted), "/", nrow(luad_df), "\n")
cat("LUSC — targeted cases found in CSV:",
    sum(lusc_df$case_id %in% lusc_all_targeted), "/", nrow(lusc_df), "\n")

# Filter
luad_nt_raw <- luad_df %>% filter(!case_id %in% luad_all_targeted)
lusc_nt_raw <- lusc_df %>% filter(!case_id %in% lusc_all_targeted)

# Fix column types (actual column names: os_months, os_status, RiskScore)
fix_types <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    os_months  = as.numeric(os_months),
    os_status  = as.integer(os_status),
    across(all_of(log2_cols_2mir), as.numeric)
  )
}

luad_nt_raw <- fix_types(luad_nt_raw)
lusc_nt_raw <- fix_types(lusc_nt_raw)

cat("\n═══ NON-TARGETED COHORT SIZES ═══\n")
cat("LUAD — original:", nrow(luad_df),
    "| excluded:", length(luad_all_targeted),
    "| remaining:", nrow(luad_nt_raw),
    "| events:", sum(luad_nt_raw$os_status), "\n")
cat("LUSC — original:", nrow(lusc_df),
    "| excluded:", length(lusc_all_targeted),
    "| remaining:", nrow(lusc_nt_raw),
    "| events:", sum(lusc_nt_raw$os_status), "\n")

write.csv(
  data.frame(case_id = luad_nt_raw$case_id),
  "luad_nontargeted_cases.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(case_id = lusc_nt_raw$case_id),
  "lusc_nontargeted_cases.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("✓ Non-targeted case ID lists exported:\n")
cat("  luad_nontargeted_cases.csv —", nrow(luad_nt_raw), "cases\n")
cat("  lusc_nontargeted_cases.csv —", nrow(lusc_nt_raw), "cases\n")
# ==============================================================================
# PART 4 — Z-score WITHIN non-targeted subset → recompute 2-miRNA risk score
#
# Critical: must NOT use z-scores from the full cohort CSV —
# those were computed before targeted cases were removed.
# ==============================================================================

compute_2mir_score <- function(df, cohort_label) {

  cat("\n── Recomputing 2-miRNA score:", cohort_label, "──\n")

  # Check log2 distributions before z-scoring
  for (col in log2_cols_2mir) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s — zero: %.1f%% | mean: %.3f | sd: %.3f\n",
                col,
                100 * mean(df[[col]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                mean(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                sd(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)))
  }

  # Z-score within this subset
  z_mat <- scale(df[, log2_cols_2mir])
  cat("  Z-score means:", paste(round(colMeans(z_mat), 4), collapse=", "), "\n")
  cat("  Z-score SDs:  ", paste(round(apply(z_mat, 2, sd), 4), collapse=", "), "\n")

  # Risk score = β1×z(509-3p) + β2×z(377-3p)
  risk_score    <- as.vector(z_mat %*% beta_2mir[log2_cols_2mir])
  df$RiskScore  <- risk_score
  df$RiskGroup  <- factor(
    ifelse(risk_score >= median(risk_score), "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )

  cat("  Score range:", round(range(risk_score), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Median cutoff:", round(median(risk_score), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Low:", sum(df$RiskGroup=="Low"),
      "| High:", sum(df$RiskGroup=="High"), "\n")
  cat("  Events — Low:", sum(df$os_status[df$RiskGroup=="Low"]),
      "| High:", sum(df$os_status[df$RiskGroup=="High"]), "\n")
  df
}

luad_nt <- compute_2mir_score(luad_nt_raw, "TCGA-LUAD (Non-Targeted)")
lusc_nt <- compute_2mir_score(lusc_nt_raw, "TCGA-LUSC (Non-Targeted)")

# Save processed files
write.csv(luad_nt, "TCGA_LUAD_NT_2mir_risk_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lusc_nt, "TCGA_LUSC_NT_2mir_risk_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n✓ Non-targeted 2-miRNA risk score CSVs written.\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 5 — Validation function
# ==============================================================================

MIN_N      <- 20
MIN_EVENTS <- 5

# ==============================================================================
# PART 5 FIX — surv_obj scoping for ggsurvplot
# Replace the two lines inside validate_2mir_nt() and re-run
# ==============================================================================

validate_2mir_nt <- function(df, cohort_name,
                              col_hi    = "#B22222",
                              col_lo    = "#1874CD",
                              roc_times = c(12, 24, 36, 60)) {

  n_total  <- nrow(df)
  n_events <- sum(df$os_status)

  if (n_total < MIN_N || n_events < MIN_EVENTS) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠  %s skipped: n=%d, events=%d\n",
                cohort_name, n_total, n_events))
    return(list(cohort=cohort_name, n=n_total, events=n_events,
                HR=NA, HR_lo=NA, HR_hi=NA, cox_p=NA,
                lr_p=NA, cindex=NA, auc_df=NULL, skipped=TRUE))
  }

  cat("\n══════════════════════════════════════════\n")
  cat("Validating:", cohort_name, "\n")
  cat(sprintf("n = %d | events = %d (%.1f%%)\n",
              n_total, n_events, 100*mean(df$os_status)))
  print(table(df$RiskGroup))

  # ── KEY FIX: <<- assigns to parent env so ggsurvplot can find surv_obj ──
  surv_obj <<- Surv(df$os_months, df$os_status)

  # ── Cox (continuous) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cox_fit <- coxph(surv_obj ~ RiskScore, data=df, ties="efron")
  s       <- summary(cox_fit)
  hr      <- s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_lo   <- s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_hi   <- s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  cox_p   <- s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  cindex  <- as.numeric(s$concordance["C"])

  cat(sprintf("Cox — HR: %.3f (%.3f–%.3f) | p = %.4f | C-index: %.3f\n",
              hr, hr_lo, hr_hi, cox_p, cindex))

  # ── Log-rank ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ RiskGroup, data=df)
  lr     <- survdiff(surv_obj ~ RiskGroup, data=df)
  lr_p   <- pchisq(lr$chisq, df=1, lower.tail=FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("Log-rank p = %.4f\n", lr_p))

  # ── Time-dependent ROC ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  valid_times <- roc_times[sapply(roc_times, function(t)
    sum(df$os_months >= t) >= 20)]

  auc_df <- NULL
  if (length(valid_times) > 0) {
    tryCatch({
      troc     <- timeROC(T=df$os_months, delta=df$os_status,
                          marker=df$RiskScore, cause=1,
                          times=valid_times, iid=TRUE)
      auc_vals <- as.numeric(troc$AUC)
      ci_mat   <- confint(troc, level=0.95)$CI_AUC

      auc_df <- data.frame(
        Cohort    = cohort_name,
        Timepoint = valid_times,
        AUC       = round(auc_vals,    4),
        AUC_lower = round(ci_mat[,1],  4),
        AUC_upper = round(ci_mat[,2],  4)
      )
      cat("Time-ROC AUC (95% CI):\n")
      print(auc_df[, -1])

      n_t      <- length(valid_times)
      roc_cols <- c("#B22222","#E88B00","#1874CD","#2ECC71")[seq_len(n_t)]
      roc_df   <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_t), function(i) {
        data.frame(
          FPR  = troc$FP[, i],
          TPR  = troc$TP[, i],
          Time = sprintf("%d mo  AUC=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                         valid_times[i], auc_vals[i],
                         ci_mat[i,1], ci_mat[i,2])
        )
      }))

      p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x=FPR, y=TPR, color=Time)) +
        geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed",
                    color="grey60", linewidth=0.5) +
        geom_line(linewidth=0.9) +
        scale_color_manual(values=setNames(roc_cols, unique(roc_df$Time)),
                           name=NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous("1 - Specificity", limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0.01,0)) +
        scale_y_continuous("Sensitivity",     limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0.01,0)) +
        labs(title    = paste0(cohort_name, " — Time-dependent ROC"),
             subtitle = "2-miRNA z-score (non-targeted) | IPCW | 95% CI") +
        theme_bw(base_size=10) +
        theme(legend.position   = c(0.58, 0.16),
              legend.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey80"),
              legend.text       = element_text(size=8),
              plot.title        = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
              aspect.ratio      = 1)

      out_roc <- paste0("TimeROC_2mir_NT_",
                        gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_", cohort_name), ".png")
      ggsave(out_roc, p_roc, width=6.5, height=6.5, dpi=300)
      cat("Time-ROC saved →", out_roc, "\n")

    }, error = function(e) cat("timeROC failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"))
  } else {
    cat("No valid ROC timepoints\n")
  }

  # ── KM plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  x_max <- min(ceiling(quantile(df$os_months, 0.95)/12)*12, 120)
  brk   <- ifelse(x_max >= 120, 36, ifelse(x_max > 60, 24, 12))

  km_subtitle <- sprintf(
    "HR = %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f–%.2f) | Cox p = %s | Log-rank p = %s | C-index = %.3f",
    hr, hr_lo, hr_hi,
    formatC(cox_p, digits=3, format="g"),
    formatC(lr_p,  digits=3, format="g"),
    cindex
  )

  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data=df,
    palette             = c(col_lo, col_hi),
    size                = 0.85,
    pval                = FALSE,
    conf.int            = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha      = 0.10,
    risk.table          = TRUE,
    risk.table.height   = 0.28,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3,
    risk.table.y.text   = FALSE,
    tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape        = "|", censor.size=3,
    surv.median.line    = "hv",
    legend.labs  = c(paste0("Low risk  (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup=="Low"),  ")"),
                     paste0("High risk (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup=="High"), ")")),
    legend.title = "",
    xlab         = "Time (months)",
    ylab         = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim         = c(0, x_max),
    break.time.by = brk,
    ylim         = c(0, 1.02),
    title        = paste0(cohort_name,
                          " — 2-miRNA signature (z-score, non-targeted)"),
    ggtheme      = theme_bw(base_size=10) +
      theme(plot.title        = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
            plot.subtitle     = element_text(size=8, color="grey30",
                                              margin=margin(b=4)),
            legend.position   = c(0.78, 0.84),
            legend.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey80",
                                              linewidth=0.3))
  )
  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot + labs(subtitle = km_subtitle)

  out_km <- paste0("KM_2mir_NT_",
                   gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_", cohort_name), ".png")
  png(out_km, width=2200, height=2000, res=300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("KM saved →", out_km, "\n")

  # ── Risk distribution plot ────────────────────────────────────────────
  rs_ord <- df %>% arrange(RiskScore) %>% mutate(idx=row_number())

  p_dist <- ggplot(rs_ord,
                   aes(x=idx, y=RiskScore,
                       color=RiskGroup, shape=factor(os_status))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=median(df$RiskScore), linetype="dashed",
               color="grey40", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_point(size=1.2, alpha=0.75) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("Low"=col_lo, "High"=col_hi),
                       name="Risk group") +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c("0"=1, "1"=16),
                       labels=c("Alive/censored","Dead"),
                       name="Status") +
    labs(title    = paste0(cohort_name, " — Risk score distribution"),
         subtitle = sprintf("n=%d | events=%d | median cutoff=%.3f",
                            nrow(df), sum(df$os_status),
                            median(df$RiskScore)),
         x = "Patients (sorted by risk score)",
         y = "Risk score (2-miRNA z-scored)") +
    theme_bw(base_size=10) +
    theme(plot.title       = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
          plot.subtitle    = element_text(color="grey40", size=9),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  out_dist <- paste0("RiskDist_2mir_NT_",
                     gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]","_", cohort_name), ".png")
  ggsave(out_dist, p_dist, width=8, height=4, dpi=300)
  cat("Risk dist saved →", out_dist, "\n")

  list(cohort=cohort_name, n=n_total, events=n_events,
       HR=hr, HR_lo=hr_lo, HR_hi=hr_hi,
       cox_p=cox_p, lr_p=lr_p, cindex=cindex,
       auc_df=auc_df, skipped=FALSE)
}

# add_stage() — reused from original pipeline
to_title <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    words <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(s)), "\\s+")[[1]]
    words <- sapply(words, function(w) {
      if (w %in% c("i","ia","ib","ii","iia","iib",
                   "iii","iiia","iiib","iv","iva","ivb"))
        toupper(w)
      else paste0(toupper(substr(w,1,1)), substr(w,2,nchar(w)))
    })
    paste(words, collapse=" ")
  }, USE.NAMES=FALSE)
}

add_stage <- function(risk_df, clin_df, cohort_name) {
  colnames(clin_df) <- tolower(colnames(clin_df))
  barcode_col <- intersect(c("bcr_patient_barcode","submitter_id","case_id"),
                            colnames(clin_df))[1]
  stage_col   <- intersect(c("ajcc_pathologic_stage",
                               "ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage",
                               "tumor_stage","clinical_stage",
                               "pathologic_stage"),
                            colnames(clin_df))[1]

  if (is.na(stage_col)) {
    warning(cohort_name, ": no stage column found")
    return(risk_df %>% mutate(stage_group=NA_character_,
                               stage_fine =NA_character_))
  }

  cat("[STAGE]", cohort_name, "using column:", stage_col, "\n")

  stage_df <- clin_df %>%
    mutate(case_id   = toupper(substr(.data[[barcode_col]], 1, 12)),
           stage_raw = to_title(.data[[stage_col]])) %>%
    select(case_id, stage_raw) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      stage_group = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I","Stage IA","Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II","Stage IIA","Stage IIB") ~ "II",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage III","Stage IIIA","Stage IIIB") ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV","Stage IVA","Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      stage_fine = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I","Stage IA","Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II","Stage IIA","Stage IIB") ~ "II",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIA"                             ~ "IIIA",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIB"                             ~ "IIIB",
        stage_raw == "Stage III"                              ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV","Stage IVA","Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  merged   <- risk_df %>%
    left_join(stage_df %>% select(case_id, stage_group, stage_fine),
              by="case_id")
  n_staged <- sum(!is.na(merged$stage_group))
  cat(sprintf("[STAGE] %s: %d / %d samples staged\n",
              cohort_name, n_staged, nrow(merged)))
  print(table(merged$stage_fine, useNA="ifany"))
  merged
}

luad_nt_staged <- add_stage(luad_nt, luad_clin, "TCGA-LUAD (NT)")
lusc_nt_staged <- add_stage(lusc_nt, lusc_clin, "TCGA-LUSC (NT)")

if (all(is.na(luad_nt_staged$stage_group)))

# Helper: filter subset, re-apply median cutoff, validate
run_subset <- function(staged_df, stage_values, stage_col,
                        label, roc_times=c(12,24,36,60)) {
  sub_df <- staged_df %>%
    filter(.data[[stage_col]] %in% stage_values) %>%
    mutate(RiskGroup = factor(
      ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore), "High", "Low"),
      levels = c("Low","High")
    ))
  cat(sprintf("\n%s: n=%d | events=%d\n",
              label, nrow(sub_df), sum(sub_df$os_status)))
  validate_2mir_nt(sub_df, label, roc_times=roc_times)
}

                            "TCGA-LUSC NT (Stage III-IV)")
# Stage IV only

lusc_nt_stIV <- run_subset(lusc_nt_staged, "IV", "stage_group",
                            "TCGA-LUSC NT (Stage IV)",

# Stage IIIB+IV

lusc_nt_3b4  <- run_subset(lusc_nt_staged, c("IIIB","IV"), "stage_fine",

                            roc_times=c(12,24,36))

make_row <- function(label, val) {
  if (isTRUE(val$skipped)) {
    return(data.frame(
      Cohort=label, n=val$n, Events=val$events,
      HR=NA, HR_lo=NA, HR_hi=NA,
      Cox_p="skipped", Logrank_p="skipped", Cindex=NA
    ))
  }
  data.frame(
    Cohort    = label,
    n         = val$n,
    Events    = val$events,
    HR        = round(val$HR,    3),
    HR_lo     = round(val$HR_lo, 3),
    HR_hi     = round(val$HR_hi, 3),
    Cox_p     = formatC(val$cox_p, digits=3, format="g"),
    Logrank_p = formatC(val$lr_p,  digits=3, format="g"),
    Cindex    = round(val$cindex,  3)
  )
}

  make_row("TCGA-LUAD NT (Stage IIIB+IV)", luad_nt_3b4),
  make_row("TCGA-LUSC NT (Stage IIIB+IV)", lusc_nt_3b4)
)
```

#treatment response non-targeted
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RISK SCORE vs PRIMARY THERAPY OUTCOME — NON-TARGETED NSCLC
# Cohorts  : TCGA-LUAD  |  TCGA-LUSC  |  Pooled
# Subsets  : (A) All stages  |  (B) Stage III + IV
# Signature: 2-miRNA z-score (miR-509-3p + miR-377-3p)
#            hsa-miR-378h excluded — 99% zero RPM in TCGA RNA-seq
#
# Inputs (must exist in working directory):
#   TCGA_LUAD_NT_2mir_risk_scores.csv   ← from SingleMiRNA_Validation.R Part 4
#   TCGA_LUSC_NT_2mir_risk_scores.csv
#   TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds              ← for stage annotation
#   TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds
#   TCGA_LUAD_followup.rds              ← for primary_therapy_outcome_success
#   TCGA_LUSC_followup.rds
#   TCGA_LUAD_drug.rds                  ← for treatment type
#   TCGA_LUSC_drug.rds
#
# If followup/drug RDS files missing → set RUN_SUPPLEMENT_DOWNLOAD <- TRUE
#
# Outputs: Output_NT_TxResponse/ folder
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(scales)

OUT_DIR <- "Output_NT_TxResponse"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Stage subset to use for advanced analysis
ADV_STAGES <- c("III", "IV")

# Minimum group size to run statistics
MIN_N <- 10

RUN_SUPPLEMENT_DOWNLOAD <- FALSE  # TRUE only on first run


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Helper
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

save_png <- function(p, filename, w = 2200, h = 2000) {
  path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, filename)
  png(path, width = w, height = h, res = 300)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", path, "\n")
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 0 — Download clinical supplement if needed
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (RUN_SUPPLEMENT_DOWNLOAD) {
  for (project in c("TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC")) {
    prefix <- gsub("-", "_", project)
    cat("\nDownloading supplement:", project, "\n")
    q <- GDCquery(project       = project,
                  data.category = "Clinical",
                  data.type     = "Clinical Supplement",
                  data.format   = "BCR XML")
    GDCdownload(q, method = "api")
    fu   <- tryCatch(GDCprepare_clinic(q, clinical.info = "follow_up"),
                     error = function(e) { cat("  follow_up failed\n"); NULL })
    drug <- tryCatch(GDCprepare_clinic(q, clinical.info = "drug"),
                     error = function(e) { cat("  drug failed\n"); NULL })
    if (!is.null(fu))   saveRDS(fu,   paste0(prefix, "_followup.rds"))
    if (!is.null(drug)) saveRDS(drug, paste0(prefix, "_drug.rds"))
    cat("  Saved RDS files for", prefix, "\n")
  }
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1 — Load NT risk score CSVs
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Ensure correct types

  mutate(os_months = as.numeric(os_months),

lusc_nt <- lusc_nt %>%
  mutate(os_months = as.numeric(os_months),

            nrow(luad_nt), sum(luad_nt$os_status)))
cat(sprintf("LUSC NT: n=%d | events=%d\n",
            nrow(lusc_nt), sum(lusc_nt$os_status)))


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2 — Stage annotation
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds")
lusc_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds")

to_title_stage <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    words <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(s)), "\\s+")[[1]]
    words <- sapply(words, function(w) {
      if (w %in% c("i","ia","ib","ii","iia","iib",
                   "iii","iiia","iiib","iv","iva","ivb"))
        toupper(w)
      else paste0(toupper(substr(w, 1, 1)), substr(w, 2, nchar(w)))
    })
    paste(words, collapse = " ")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

attach_stage <- function(rs_df, clin_df, cohort) {
  colnames(clin_df) <- tolower(colnames(clin_df))
  bc_col <- intersect(c("bcr_patient_barcode","submitter_id","case_id"),
                      colnames(clin_df))[1]
  stage_col <- intersect(c("ajcc_pathologic_stage",
                            "ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage",
                            "tumor_stage","clinical_stage",
                            "pathologic_stage"),
                         colnames(clin_df))[1]

  cat("\n[STAGE]", cohort, "| col:", stage_col, "\n")

  stage_df <- clin_df %>%
    mutate(case_id   = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
           stage_raw = to_title_stage(.data[[stage_col]])) %>%
    select(case_id, stage_raw) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      stage_group = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I","Stage IA","Stage IB")     ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II","Stage IIA","Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage III","Stage IIIA","Stage IIIB") ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV","Stage IVA","Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      stage_fine = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I","Stage IA","Stage IB")     ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II","Stage IIA","Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIA"                              ~ "IIIA",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIB"                              ~ "IIIB",
        stage_raw == "Stage III"                               ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV","Stage IVA","Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  merged <- rs_df %>%
    left_join(stage_df %>% select(case_id, stage_group, stage_fine),
              by = "case_id")

  cat(sprintf("  Staged: %d / %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(merged$stage_group)), nrow(merged)))
  print(table(merged$stage_group, useNA = "ifany"))
  merged
}

luad_nt_staged <- attach_stage(luad_nt, luad_clin, "TCGA-LUAD NT")
lusc_nt_staged <- attach_stage(lusc_nt, lusc_clin, "TCGA-LUSC NT")

if (all(is.na(luad_nt_staged$stage_group)))
  stop("LUAD NT staging failed — check clinical RDS")
if (all(is.na(lusc_nt_staged$stage_group)))
  stop("LUSC NT staging failed — check clinical RDS")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 3 — Build primary therapy response table from follow_up supplement
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_fu   <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_followup.rds")
lusc_fu   <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_followup.rds")

build_response <- function(fu_df, cohort) {
  colnames(fu_df) <- tolower(colnames(fu_df))
  bc_col   <- intersect(c("bcr_patient_barcode","submitter_id","case_id"),
                        colnames(fu_df))[1]
  resp_col <- intersect(c("primary_therapy_outcome_success",
                           "measure_of_response",
                           "treatment_best_response",
                           "therapy_outcome_first_course"),
                        colnames(fu_df))[1]

  cat("\n[RESPONSE]", cohort,
      "| barcode:", bc_col, "| response col:", resp_col, "\n")

  if (is.na(resp_col)) {
    cat("  ⚠ No response column. Available:\n",
        paste(colnames(fu_df), collapse=", "), "\n")
    return(tibble(case_id=character(),
                  response_recist=character(),
                  response_binary=character()))
  }

  out <- fu_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id      = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
      response_raw = as.character(.data[[resp_col]]),
      response_recist = case_when(
        grepl("complete remission|complete response|^CR$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "CR",
        grepl("partial remission|partial response|^PR$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "PR",
        grepl("stable|no change|^SD$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "SD",
        grepl("progress|^PD$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "PD",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist)) %>%
    mutate(resp_rank = match(response_recist, c("CR","PR","SD","PD"))) %>%
    group_by(case_id) %>%
    arrange(resp_rank) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      response_binary = case_when(
        response_recist %in% c("CR","PR") ~ "Responder (CR+PR)",
        response_recist %in% c("SD","PD") ~ "Non-responder (SD+PD)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(case_id, response_recist, response_binary)

  cat("  Response n =", nrow(out), "\n")
  print(table(out$response_recist, useNA="ifany"))
  out
}

luad_resp <- build_response(luad_fu, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_resp <- build_response(lusc_fu, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 4 — Build treatment type table from drug supplement
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_drug <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_drug.rds")
lusc_drug <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_drug.rds")

build_tx_type <- function(drug_df, cohort) {
  colnames(drug_df) <- tolower(colnames(drug_df))
  bc_col <- intersect(c("bcr_patient_barcode","submitter_id","case_id"),
                      colnames(drug_df))[1]
  tx_col <- intersect(c("therapy_types","therapy_type",
                         "pharmaceutical_therapy_drug_name","drug_name"),
                      colnames(drug_df))[1]

  cat("\n[TX TYPE]", cohort, "| tx col:", tx_col, "\n")
  if (is.na(tx_col))
    return(tibble(case_id=character(), tx_type=character()))

  drug_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
      tx_raw  = as.character(.data[[tx_col]]),
      tx_type = case_when(
        grepl("chemo|platinum|paclitaxel|gemcitab|pemetrexed|vinorelbine|etoposide|docetaxel|carboplatin|cisplatin",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) &
          !grepl("immun|checkpoint|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|ipilimumab",
                 tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "Chemotherapy",
        grepl("immun|checkpoint|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|ipilimumab",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "Immunotherapy",
        grepl("erlotinib|gefitinib|osimertinib|crizotinib|alectinib|bevacizumab|cetuximab|afatinib|targeted",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "Targeted Therapy",
        grepl("radiat|radiation|XRT|SBRT|IMRT",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "Radiation",
        !is.na(tx_raw)                   ~ "Other",
        TRUE                             ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    select(case_id, tx_raw, tx_type)
}

luad_tx <- build_tx_type(luad_drug, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_tx <- build_tx_type(lusc_drug, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 5 — Merge function: risk scores + stage + response + tx type
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

merge_nt <- function(staged_df, resp_df, tx_df, cohort,
                     stage_filter = NULL) {

  # Optionally filter to advanced stages
  if (!is.null(stage_filter)) {
    staged_df <- staged_df %>%
      filter(stage_group %in% stage_filter)
    cat(sprintf("\n[FILTER] %s → Stage %s: n=%d\n",
                cohort, paste(stage_filter, collapse="+"), nrow(staged_df)))
    # Recompute median RiskGroup WITHIN filtered subset
    staged_df <- staged_df %>%
      mutate(RiskGroup = factor(
        ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), "High", "Low"),
        levels = c("Low","High")
      ))
  }

  out <- staged_df %>%
    left_join(resp_df, by = "case_id") %>%
    left_join(tx_df %>% select(case_id, tx_type), by = "case_id") %>%
    mutate(
      Cohort          = cohort,
      response_recist = factor(response_recist, levels=c("CR","PR","SD","PD")),
      response_binary = factor(response_binary,
                               levels=c("Responder (CR+PR)",
                                        "Non-responder (SD+PD)")),
      tx_type         = factor(tx_type,
                               levels=c("Chemotherapy","Immunotherapy",
                                        "Targeted Therapy","Radiation","Other"))
    )

  cat(sprintf("[MERGE] %s: n=%d | response=%d | tx=%d | High=%d | Low=%d\n",
              cohort, nrow(out),
              sum(!is.na(out$response_recist)),
              sum(!is.na(out$tx_type)),
              sum(out$RiskGroup=="High", na.rm=TRUE),
              sum(out$RiskGroup=="Low",  na.rm=TRUE)))
  out
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 6 — Build all 6 datasets
#   A = All stages:   LUAD | LUSC | Pooled
#   B = Stage III+IV: LUAD | LUSC | Pooled
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n══ Building datasets ══\n")

# ── A: All stages ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
luad_all <- merge_nt(luad_nt_staged, luad_resp, luad_tx, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_all <- merge_nt(lusc_nt_staged, lusc_resp, lusc_tx, "TCGA-LUSC")
pool_all <- bind_rows(luad_all, lusc_all) %>%
  mutate(Cohort    = "LUAD+LUSC",
         RiskGroup = factor(
           ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), "High", "Low"),
           levels = c("Low","High")
         ))

# ── B: Stage III + IV ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
luad_adv <- merge_nt(luad_nt_staged, luad_resp, luad_tx,
                     "TCGA-LUAD", stage_filter = ADV_STAGES)
lusc_adv <- merge_nt(lusc_nt_staged, lusc_resp, lusc_tx,
                     "TCGA-LUSC", stage_filter = ADV_STAGES)
pool_adv <- bind_rows(
  luad_nt_staged %>% filter(stage_group %in% ADV_STAGES),
  lusc_nt_staged %>% filter(stage_group %in% ADV_STAGES)
) %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(luad_resp, lusc_resp), by = "case_id") %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(luad_tx,   lusc_tx) %>%
              select(case_id, tx_type), by = "case_id") %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort          = "LUAD+LUSC",
    RiskGroup       = factor(
      ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), "High", "Low"),
      levels = c("Low","High")
    ),
    response_recist = factor(response_recist, levels=c("CR","PR","SD","PD")),
    response_binary = factor(response_binary,
                             levels=c("Responder (CR+PR)",
                                      "Non-responder (SD+PD)")),
    tx_type         = factor(tx_type,
                             levels=c("Chemotherapy","Immunotherapy",
                                      "Targeted Therapy","Radiation","Other"))
  )

cat(sprintf("\n[POOL ADV] LUAD+LUSC Stage%s: n=%d | response=%d\n",
            paste(ADV_STAGES,collapse="+"),
            nrow(pool_adv), sum(!is.na(pool_adv$response_recist))))

# Named list: all 6 datasets with descriptive labels
datasets <- list(
  "LUAD — All stages"   = luad_all,
  "LUSC — All stages"   = lusc_all,
  "LUAD+LUSC — All stages" = pool_all,
  "LUAD — Stage III+IV" = luad_adv,
  "LUSC — Stage III+IV" = lusc_adv,
  "LUAD+LUSC — Stage III+IV" = pool_adv
)

# Save merged CSVs
write.csv(luad_all,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "NT_LUAD_AllStages.csv"),      row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(lusc_all,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "NT_LUSC_AllStages.csv"),      row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(pool_all,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "NT_Pooled_AllStages.csv"),    row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(luad_adv,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "NT_LUAD_StageIIIIV.csv"),    row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(lusc_adv,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "NT_LUSC_StageIIIIV.csv"),    row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(pool_adv,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "NT_Pooled_StageIIIIV.csv"),  row.names=FALSE)
cat("✓ 6 merged CSVs saved.\n")

# PART 7 — Colour palettes

RECIST_COLS <- c("CR"="#27AE60","PR"="#2ECC71","SD"="#F39C12","PD"="#E74C3C")
BINARY_COLS <- c("Responder (CR+PR)"="#27AE60","Non-responder (SD+PD)"="#E74C3C")
TX_COLS     <- c("Chemotherapy"="#3498DB","Immunotherapy"="#9B59B6",
                 "Targeted Therapy"="#E67E22","Radiation"="#1ABC9C","Other"="#95A5A6")

# KM joint colours — UNNAMED ordered vector (avoids ggsurvplot grey bug)
JOINT_LEVELS  <- c("Low / Responder (CR+PR)", "Low / Non-responder (SD+PD)",
                   "High / Responder (CR+PR)", "High / Non-responder (SD+PD)")
JOINT_PALETTE <- c("#27AE60","#A9DFBF","#E74C3C","#F1948A")

# PART 8 — Plot functions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── 8A: Boxplot (any group variable) ──────────────────────────────────────
box_compare <- function(df, group_col, group_levels, col_vec,
                        title_str, x_label, min_n = 5) {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]]),
           as.character(.data[[group_col]]) %in% group_levels) %>%
    mutate(GV = factor(as.character(.data[[group_col]]), levels=group_levels))

  keep <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(GV) %>% summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    filter(n >= min_n) %>% pull(GV) %>% as.character()

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(GV %in% keep) %>%
    mutate(GV = factor(as.character(GV),
                       levels=group_levels[group_levels %in% keep]))

  if (length(unique(plot_df$GV)) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", title_str, "— <2 groups with n ≥", min_n, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  n_grp <- length(unique(plot_df$GV))
  if (n_grp > 2) {
    gp  <- kruskal.test(RiskScore ~ GV, data=plot_df)$p.value
    gtx <- paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", formatC(gp, digits=3, format="g"))
  } else {
    gp  <- wilcox.test(RiskScore ~ GV, data=plot_df)$p.value
    gtx <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", formatC(gp, digits=3, format="g"))
  }

  ns    <- plot_df %>% group_by(GV) %>% summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop")
  xlabs <- setNames(paste0(ns$GV,"\n(n=",ns$n,")"), as.character(ns$GV))
  pairs <- combn(levels(plot_df$GV), 2, simplify=FALSE)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x=GV, y=RiskScore, fill=GV)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, width=0.55, alpha=0.85, color="grey30") +
    geom_jitter(width=0.18, size=0.9, alpha=0.5, color="grey20") +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons=pairs, method="wilcox.test",
                       label="p.signif", tip.length=0.01,
                       step.increase=0.10, hide.ns=TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_vec, guide="none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=xlabs) +
    labs(title    = title_str,
         subtitle = paste0(gtx, "  |  2-miRNA NT signature"),
         x = x_label,
         y = "2-miRNA Risk Score (z-scored)") +
    theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    theme(plot.title       = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
          plot.subtitle    = element_text(color="grey40", size=10, face="italic"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x      = element_text(size=10))
}

# ── 8B: Stacked bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_stacked_bar <- function(df, title_str) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist), !is.na(RiskGroup)) %>%
    mutate(response_recist = factor(response_recist, levels=c("CR","PR","SD","PD")),
           RiskGroup        = factor(RiskGroup, levels=c("Low","High")))

  if (nrow(plot_df) < MIN_N) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", title_str, "— n <", MIN_N, "\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  ct  <- tryCatch(chisq.test(table(plot_df$RiskGroup, plot_df$response_recist)),
                  error=function(e) list(p.value=NA))
  plb <- ifelse(is.na(ct$p.value), "Chi-sq p = NA",
                paste0("Chi-sq p = ", formatC(ct$p.value, digits=3, format="g")))

  prop_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(RiskGroup, response_recist) %>%
    summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(RiskGroup) %>%
    mutate(total=sum(n), pct=100*n/total,
           label=ifelse(pct>=6, paste0(round(pct,1),"%"), "")) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(prop_df, aes(x=RiskGroup, y=pct, fill=response_recist)) +
    geom_col(width=0.6, color="white", linewidth=0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label=label), position=position_stack(vjust=0.5),
              size=3.5, color="white", fontface="bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=RECIST_COLS, name="Response") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
                       expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,105)) +
    labs(title    = title_str,
         subtitle = paste0(plb, "  |  2-miRNA NT signature"),
         x="Risk Group", y="Proportion of Patients (%)") +
    theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    theme(plot.title         = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
          plot.subtitle      = element_text(color="grey40", size=10, face="italic"),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}

# ── 8C: KM risk group × response ──────────────────────────────────────────
km_risk_x_response <- function(df, title_str, file_slug) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_binary), !is.na(RiskGroup),
           !is.na(os_months), !is.na(os_status)) %>%
    mutate(Joint = paste0(as.character(RiskGroup), " / ",
                          as.character(response_binary)),
           Joint = factor(Joint, levels=JOINT_LEVELS)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Joint))

  n_groups <- length(unique(droplevels(plot_df$Joint)))
  if (nrow(plot_df) < MIN_N || n_groups < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", title_str, "— n =", nrow(plot_df),
        "| groups =", n_groups, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cat(sprintf("  [KM] %s: n=%d | events=%d | groups=%d\n",
              title_str, nrow(plot_df), sum(plot_df$os_status), n_groups))

  # Align palette to only present levels (unnamed → position-based)
  present_levels  <- JOINT_LEVELS[JOINT_LEVELS %in% unique(plot_df$Joint)]
  present_palette <- JOINT_PALETTE[JOINT_LEVELS %in% unique(plot_df$Joint)]
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(Joint = factor(as.character(Joint), levels=present_levels))

  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data=plot_df)
  lr_p   <- 1 - pchisq(
    survdiff(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data=plot_df)$chisq,
    df = n_groups - 1
  )

  x_max <- min(ceiling(quantile(plot_df$os_months, 0.95)/12)*12, 120)
  brk   <- ifelse(x_max > 60, 24, 12)

  ns      <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(Joint) %>%
    summarise(n=n(), ev=sum(os_status), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(match(Joint, present_levels))
  leg_labs <- paste0(ns$Joint, " (n=", ns$n, ", ev=", ns$ev, ")")

  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data=plot_df,
    palette             = present_palette,  # unnamed vector — colour fix
    size                = 0.9,
    pval                = FALSE,
    conf.int            = FALSE,
    risk.table          = TRUE,
    risk.table.height   = 0.30,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3,
    risk.table.y.text   = FALSE,
    tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape        = "|", censor.size=3,
    surv.median.line    = "hv",
    legend.labs         = leg_labs,
    legend.title        = "",
    xlab  = "Time (months)",
    ylab  = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim  = c(0, x_max),
    break.time.by = brk,
    ylim  = c(0, 1.02),
    title = title_str,
    ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size=10) +
      theme(plot.title        = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
            plot.subtitle     = element_text(size=8, color="grey30"),
            legend.position   = c(0.70, 0.78),
            legend.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey80",
                                              linewidth=0.3),
            legend.text       = element_text(size=7.5),
            panel.grid.minor  = element_blank())
  )
  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(
      "Log-rank p = ", formatC(lr_p, digits=3, format="g"),
      "  |  2-miRNA NT  |  Dark=Responder · Green=Low · Red=High"
    ))

  out <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("KM_NT_RiskGroup_x_Response_", file_slug, ".png"))
  png(out, width=2400, height=2400, res=300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out, "\n")
}

# ── 8D: Logistic regression ───────────────────────────────────────────────
run_logistic <- function(df, label) {
  sub <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_binary), !is.na(RiskScore)) %>%
    mutate(Responder = as.integer(response_binary == "Responder (CR+PR)"))
  if (nrow(sub) < MIN_N || length(unique(sub$Responder)) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP logistic]", label, "\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  fit <- glm(Responder ~ RiskScore, data=sub, family=binomial)
  s   <- summary(fit)
  or  <- exp(coef(fit)["RiskScore"])
  ci  <- exp(confint.default(fit)["RiskScore",])
  p   <- s$coefficients["RiskScore","Pr(>|z|)"]
  cat(sprintf("  %s: OR=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f) p=%s\n",
              label, or, ci[1], ci[2], formatC(p, digits=3, format="g")))
  data.frame(Label=label, n=nrow(sub), n_resp=sum(sub$Responder),
             OR=round(or,3), OR_lo95=round(ci[1],3), OR_hi95=round(ci[2],3),
             p_value=formatC(p, digits=3, format="g"))
}

# PART 9 — Run all plots across all 6 datasets
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Metadata for each dataset: label, file slug, stage description
ds_meta <- list(
  list(key="LUAD — All stages",        slug="LUAD_AllStages",
       label="TCGA-LUAD NT (all stages)"),
  list(key="LUSC — All stages",        slug="LUSC_AllStages",
       label="TCGA-LUSC NT (all stages)"),
  list(key="LUAD+LUSC — All stages",   slug="Pooled_AllStages",
       label="LUAD+LUSC NT (all stages)"),
  list(key="LUAD — Stage III+IV",      slug="LUAD_StageIIIIV",
       label="TCGA-LUAD NT (Stage III+IV)"),
  list(key="LUSC — Stage III+IV",      slug="LUSC_StageIIIIV",
       label="TCGA-LUSC NT (Stage III+IV)"),
  list(key="LUAD+LUSC — Stage III+IV", slug="Pooled_StageIIIIV",
       label="LUAD+LUSC NT (Stage III+IV)")
)

all_logistic <- list()
all_summary  <- list()

for (meta in ds_meta) {
  df    <- datasets[[meta$key]]
  slug  <- meta$slug
  label <- meta$label

  cat(sprintf("\n══════ %s ══════\n", label))

  # ── 4-level RECIST boxplot ───────────────────────────────────────────
  p4 <- box_compare(df, "response_recist", c("CR","PR","SD","PD"),
                    RECIST_COLS,
                    paste0(label, "  —  Risk Score by Primary Therapy Outcome"),
                    "Primary Therapy Outcome (RECIST)")
  if (!is.null(p4))
    save_png(p4, paste0("NT_RiskScore_RECIST4_", slug, ".png"))

  # ── Binary boxplot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p2 <- box_compare(df, "response_binary",
                    c("Responder (CR+PR)","Non-responder (SD+PD)"),
                    BINARY_COLS,
                    paste0(label, "  —  Risk Score by Treatment Response"),
                    "Treatment Response")
  if (!is.null(p2))
    save_png(p2, paste0("NT_RiskScore_ResponseBinary_", slug, ".png"),
             w=1600, h=1800)

  # ── Treatment type boxplot ───────────────────────────────────────────
  ptx <- box_compare(df, "tx_type",
                     c("Chemotherapy","Immunotherapy",
                       "Targeted Therapy","Radiation","Other"),
                     TX_COLS,
                     paste0(label, "  —  Risk Score by Treatment Type"),
                     "Treatment Type")
  if (!is.null(ptx))
    save_png(ptx, paste0("NT_RiskScore_TxType_", slug, ".png"))

  # ── Stacked bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pb <- make_stacked_bar(
    df, paste0(label, "  —  Response Distribution by Risk Group")
  )
  if (!is.null(pb))
    save_png(pb, paste0("NT_ResponseBar_byRiskGroup_", slug, ".png"),
             w=1600, h=1800)

  # ── KM risk × response ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_risk_x_response(
    df,
    paste0(label, " — OS by Risk Group \u00d7 Primary Therapy Outcome"),
    slug
  )

  # ── Logistic regression ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  lr <- run_logistic(df, label)
  if (!is.null(lr)) all_logistic[[length(all_logistic)+1]] <- lr

  # ── Per-group summary stats ──────────────────────────────────────────
  grp_stats <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist)) %>%
    group_by(Response = as.character(response_recist)) %>%
    summarise(n=n(),
              Median_RiskScore = round(median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
              Mean_RiskScore   = round(mean(RiskScore,   na.rm=TRUE), 4),
              SD_RiskScore     = round(sd(RiskScore,     na.rm=TRUE), 4),
              .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(Dataset = label)
  if (nrow(grp_stats) > 0)
    all_summary[[length(all_summary)+1]] <- grp_stats
}
```
